resources.string: Data lives only on this device. No account needed.
Ruthenia Store is an open client for installing and updating apps from RuStore. No tracking, no banners, no clutter.

No analytics and no ad SDKs. The network is used only for the RuStore catalog and downloads plus a one-off download of the official Mintsifry certificates on a manual refresh, and the list of installed apps is read locally.
Before installing, the downloaded APK signature is checked against the installed app. Multi-APK and split builds install in a single session.
This project is not affiliated with RuStore or VK and runs on a non-public API. If the API changes, the app may temporarily stop fetching data until it is updated.
